name: mistral-moderation
description:
Validates request or response body content with the Mistral moderation API (mistral-moderation-2603).
Moderates raw text (/v1/moderations) or a conversation (/v1/chat/moderations), where the last message is judged in the context of the earlier ones and a reply is judged against its prompt.
Scores content across eleven categories (sexual, hate and discrimination, violence and threats, dangerous, criminal, self-harm, health, financial, law, PII and jailbreaking) and blocks content whose score reaches a configurable per-category threshold.
Supports JSONPath extraction, streamed (stream: true) and non-streamed responses (a streamed reply is reassembled and moderated before it is delivered), separate configuration for request and response phases, and a configurable timeout. The Mistral API key is configured by the gateway administrator, never in the API definition.
